## History

Janet Sweet lived at her charmingly peculiar home, [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside), in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), where she welcomed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a boarder. She maintained a twenty-year romance with [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), who routinely walked her home from prayer meetings but failed to propose. After crying on her twentieth anniversary and brief encouragement from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to show spirit, Janet briefly rejected John's company, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) quickly intervened to reunite them. Following the death of John's mother, John explained that a secret vow to his late mother had prevented him from proposing sooner, leading Janet to forgive the woman and accept his marriage proposal.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P1](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0001), [v3 ch.Romance P2](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0002), [v3 ch.Romance P5](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0005), [v3 ch.Romance P6](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0006), [v3 ch.Romance P7](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0007), [v3 ch.Romance P8](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0008), +86 more_

## Quotes

> "If she wasn’t—but she is. So we mustn’t speak evil of her. But I’m happy at last, Anne. And I wouldn’t have minded waiting so long a bit if I’d only known why."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Last P47](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0047)

> "Oh, she does. She’s told me time and again that she’d love to see John settled before her time comes. She’s always giving him hints—you heard her yourself the other day. I thought I’d ha’ gone through the floor."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P10](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0010)

> “I couldn’t,” said poor Janet pathetically. “You see, Anne, I’ve always been awful fond of John. He might just as well keep coming as not, for there was never anybody else I’d want, so it didn’t matter.”
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013)

> "No, I guess not. I was afraid to try, anyway, for fear he’d think I meant it and just go. I suppose I’m a poor-spirited creature, but that is how I feel. And I can’t help it."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P16](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0016)

> “I dunno,” said Janet hopelessly. “I dunno if I could ever get up enough spunk. Things have drifted so long. But I’ll think it over.”
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P18](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0018)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--janet.md)

Janet serves as Anne's hostess when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes to board at her [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) home, [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside). The two become close confidantes who share personal stories and laugh over local suitors, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) taking a keen interest in Janet's long-standing romantic troubles. When Janet despairs over her stagnant courtship, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) encourages her to stand up for herself and later intervenes directly in Janet's love life.

- Friend of — confidantes who share personal stories  <sub>[v3 ch.Last P24](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0024), [v3 ch.Last P45](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0045)</sub>

### [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/janet--john-douglas.md)

Janet and John maintain a prolonged romantic courtship that spans twenty years without a proposal. Though Janet briefly rebels against the stagnation by rejecting his offer to walk her home from a prayer meeting, she quickly regrets it. After the death of John's domineering mother—who had bound him to a secret deathbed vow for nineteen years—John finally proposes to Janet, leading her to forgive his mother and accept.

- Romantically involved with — courting  <sub>[v3 ch.Douglas P8](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0008), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036)</sub>
